hints.title: Distinguishing Cash Inflows and Outflows
hints.text: A user spends money when appearing as paid_by and receives money when appearing as paid_to.

hints.title: Aggregating Transactions Separately
hints.text: aggregate total debits grouped by paid_by and total credits grouped by paid_to in separate subqueries or CTEs.

hints.title: Net Credit Balance and Breach Check
hints.text: join users with the aggregated flows using left join, treating nulls as 0. check if net credit is strictly negative.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT u.user_id,
       u.user_name,
       u.credit - IFNULL(outflow.total_out, 0) + IFNULL(inflow.total_in, 0) AS credit,
       CASE
           WHEN u.credit - IFNULL(outflow.total_out, 0) + IFNULL(inflow.total_in, 0) < 0 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS credit_limit_breached
FROM Users u
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT paid_by, SUM(amount) AS total_out
    FROM Transactions
    GROUP BY paid_by
) outflow ON u.user_id = outflow.paid_by
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT paid_to, SUM(amount) AS total_in
    FROM Transactions
    GROUP BY paid_to
) inflow ON u.user_id = inflow.paid_to;
```

complexity.notes: Computes sum of inflows and outflows across transactions and joins with user profiles.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Joining transactions directly on both fields in a single join multiplies rows and produces incorrect balances.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Independent pre-aggregations by sender and receiver prevent cross-product multiplication.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pre-aggregating inflows and outflows separately before joining with users table.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def bank_account_summary(users: pd.DataFrame, transactions: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    spent = transactions.groupby('paid_by')['amount'].sum().reset_index().rename(columns={'paid_by': 'user_id', 'amount': 'out'})
    rcvd = transactions.groupby('paid_to')['amount'].sum().reset_index().rename(columns={'paid_to': 'user_id', 'amount': 'in'})
    df = users.merge(spent, on='user_id', how='left').merge(rcvd, on='user_id', how='left')
    df['out'] = df['out'].fillna(0)
    df['in'] = df['in'].fillna(0)
    df['credit'] = df['credit'] - df['out'] + df['in']
    df['credit_limit_breached'] = df['credit'].apply(lambda c: 'Yes' if c < 0 else 'No')
    return df[['user_id', 'user_name', 'credit', 'credit_limit_breached']]
